requirements.requirement: Scan all 244 signals and isolate every positive net outcome
requirements.proof: 244 unique candidates; all six policy/stress winner subsets checked against frozen valid net_price_units > 0.

requirements.requirement: Winner-only feature correlation and common denominator
requirements.proof: Six 29x29 winner-only matrices; 5046 correlation cells independently recomputed; winner/nonwinner distributions and all-winner envelope evaluated.

requirements.requirement: Automated exact lambda/T profit optimization without individual tuning
requirements.proof: Every one of 60516 upper-tail pairs tested; direct integer cash audit certifies 15 complete/partial/stress optima, with deterministic ties.

requirements.requirement: Global stress test over full 244-candidate pool
requirements.proof: All chosen rules applied to all 244; both structural matching stresses retained, existing execution and exits fixed.

requirements.requirement: Total net P/L divided by total number of signals
requirements.proof: Primary global density uses 244 denominator, separately from selected/filled counts. Resolved passive=119.444/244; resolved market=482.724/244.

requirements.requirement: Failure rate and high-lambda zero-profit outcomes
requirements.proof: Joint-rule and high-lambda-only counts separate profits, losses, zero/unfilled and unknown outcomes; passive failure 10/12; market losing count 3/7.

requirements.requirement: Systemic Rule Report with exact rule, maximum and capture count
requirements.proof: Aggregate policy/cohort report, no named individual-signal case study. Exact full-precision cutoffs, counts, global metric, winner DNA, validation and unknown-P/L limits included.

scope_limit: The analysis and requested report are complete. No claim of a systemic production edge or of maximum total P/L for cohorts containing unresolved outcomes.
